newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bollore could buy AOM with BA.
newsitem.headline: Bollore could buy AOM with BA.

text.p: The French Bollore group would be interested in buying the AOM airline alongside British Airways Plc (BA), if the company came up for sale, Bollore managing director and deputy chairman Jean-Paul Parayre said on Friday.
"If one day AOM were for sale, in conditions of transparency, we would without doubt be a candidate with British Airways for the purchase," he said in an interview with newspaper Les Echos.
CDR, the state-backed holding company selling off assets of the Credit Lyonnais bank, owns AOM.

Vincent Bollore, chairman of the Bollore Technologies trading group and private holding company Financiere Moncey, is also chairman of Banque Rivaud, which has joined with BA to bid for insolvent Air Liberte.
